actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welcome to Safety School’s Safe To Go VR safety training modules on FLC Stacker Operations. Today you'll cover PPE, pre-checks, area readiness, and loading of the FLC’s using a stacker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You will be an associate who will handle these transfers.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Tap the highlighted Continue button on the panel.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Gear up before entering the site, put on your safety vest, helmet, ankle safety shoes, and impact gloves,","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Put on all four PPE items before continuing.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now that you're geared up, let's take a look around the work area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This is where the battery-operated stacker is used to move FLCs for loading and unloading around the docking area.","waitForCompletion":false,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we start the operation, you need to understand the three zones.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Orange is the operational zone. Whenever you use the stacker, it should be within this operational zone.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Finally, any pallet load that has to be carried would be placed inside the blue colored marked areas.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, let's proceed with the pre-inspection procedure for the stacker. To begin with, grab the phone.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's start with the pre-inspection checklist. Grab the phone.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Go closer to the barcode on the stacker and scan the operator barcode using the phone.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Scan the barcode with your phone to get the inspection points.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Scan the barcode with your phone to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Since filling out the checklist on the phone isn’t practical in VR, all phone interactions will be completed through the UI panel.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The first option is to select Site. Go ahead and select your site.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, would be date. Tap on the box to enter today's date.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Third step would be select shift. Pick on day shift.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Fourth would be type of loading. Pick loading on the options available.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, would be to enter the inspected by. Tap on the box to enter the name.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Last on this page would be language. Please select your preferred language under it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Click on the respective options to completed the operator checklist.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Click on each option to complete the operator checklist.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: ChecklistUIToggle
actions.Data: {"titleText":"Introduction & Prechecks","toggleInfos":["Complete Vehicle Inspection","Area Readiness Audit","Barricade area","Add do not enter tape","Inspect Dock area"],"waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"On the second page, we have checklist specific to the stacker. Let’s start doing the check. First inspection is to check the condition of the wheel.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Check the wheel condition and select Yes or No based on the wheel condition.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, let’s check if the stacker is free of any unusual noise, let me turn it on","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Is the stacker free of unusual noise? Click Yes or No.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Third step would be to check the mast lifting and lowering smoothly without jerks or delays. Move the lever up and gauge if it’s moving smoothly.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good, it’s working well. Let me update the condition to yes.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Fourth would be, to check if there’s any oil leak in this area. Can you point at any oil leak if present?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Fantastic, let me clear it for you and report the oil leak.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, check whether the battery level is adequate for operation?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, check that the biometric authentication system is working properly.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, we need to check the condition of the forks for any cracks, bends or wear.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Can you confirm by tapping on the checklist?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Lastly, check whether the steering responds smoothly and accurately. Move the stacker and forward to test this.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Amazing the stacker steering is functioning correctly, let me update it on the checklist.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"In the interest of time, let me inspect all other prechecks and update the checklist.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Tap on the submit button to complete the checklist.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Click on the respective options to completed the operator checklist.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Click on each option to complete the operator checklist.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now the area manager would perform the area readiness inspection using the checklist.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now that GTDR or area readiness is inspected, we need to barricade the surrounding work area with tape and cones. Grab a cone and place it at the highlighted spot.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the cone and place it to mark out the work area.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the highlighted cone and place it at the marked position.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, let me barricade the work area as well as the docking area for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab and place the “do not enter” tape to add it around the barricading cones.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the tape and place it on the cone to barricade out the work area.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the highlighted tape and place it at the marked position.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, we have barricaded the area successfully. Let's move closer to the stacker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before bringing the stacker into the docking area, inspect the lighting, check for fallen shipments, and examine the floor base plates and dock levellers. Can you identify all the irregularities in the area?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take a closer look around the docking area. Point if anything seems unsafe or out of place.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look carefully at the lighting, floor, shipments, and dock levellers. Identify anything that needs attention.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, make it a point to check the docking area before loading or unloading","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Data: {"text":"Turn the ignition key to turn on the stacker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Fantstic, the stacker is operational now. Notice there are two glow lights on the stacker reflected on the floor? One is red and the other is blue. These indications are for passerby to be aware of the incoming stacker and marks the safe zone beyond which they can move around in the warehouse.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Authenticate at the biometric scanner, by placing your thumb finger on the highlighted spot. First, let’s remove your gloves for that.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good, now use the scanner with your thumb finger.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Interact with the highlighted biometric access using your thumb finger to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Your task today is to move the FLC using the stacker and load it inside the truck.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"First, let’s retrieve the stacker from the parking yard. A cone placed on the pallet in a parked stacker is a parking protocol. Grab the cone from the pallet to remove it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Lift the cone placed on top of the pallet before moving the stacker out of its parking spot.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Please lift the cone from the pallet to continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let’s retrieve the stacker from the parking yard. Lift the stacker with the stacker cover up before moving it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Lift the mast before moving the stacker out of its parking spot.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Move the forklift cover to the highlighted area. Reverse while turning the stacker left by pushing the steering paddle backward and turning the steering handle to the right.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good, Turn the stacker and position it inside the pallet at the highlighted spot.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Use the steering and the paddles to align the forks inside the pallet within the highlighted spot.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Use the steering and the paddles to align the forks inside the pallet within the highlighted spot before continuing.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Lower the mast to place the pallet down on the floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Lower the mast to release the stacker cover onto the floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Please finish placing the stacker cover down to continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"let me help to move the stacker from parking area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The stacker is removed from the parking yard, let’s move towards the load that needs to be loaded on the truck.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Data: {"text":"Your task today is to move this FLC using the stacker inside the truck. Go ahead and push the stacker toward the load so that the fork is completely inserted under the FLC.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we head back, take a look at the green path on the floor, that's the exact route you drove to reach here.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Data: {"text":"Great work here on loading using the stacker.”","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we park the stacker at the parking bay, let’s see a few bad practices of using the stacker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Here’s an Inbound associate passing next to stacker. Let us see how the scene unfolds.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This is a bad practice, make sure pedestrians are not standing or walking under the load while moving the load at a height.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"I want to show you one more bad practice before we continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Never lift a person by the forks on the stacker or use it as a scissor lift. It could be dangerous.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Fantastic, your docking shift is completed, let’s moving to the parking spot.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}
